fields.summary: Autonomous plan run, no owner. The planner read CI run 43333843332 attempt 1 (PR #513, head 7a96ac2): TestScripts/headless-run-agent-tabs failed because leaf b's verifier was judged 'verifier ended with neither Evidence nor findings' although the fake claude only exits after rhiza add evidence and rhiza link verifies succeed; leaf a's verifier wrote concurrently and passed; b's builder retries then failed with exit 1 (its leaf file was already committed). The planner traced the verdict to stepRunner.Evidence, which reads through readModel's cached answers (internal/api/run_model_cache.go: catchUpModel, refreshDue, revalidate). The planner asked whether to fix the product race, fix only the test's timing, or quarantine; the arbiter ruled (Decision verifier-evidence-read-fresh) to treat it as a run-driver bug: reproduce with an injected delay, make the verdict on a just-ended session read a model caught up past its writes, add a regression test below the testscript, and quarantine with a bug filed only if it cannot be reproduced or fixed here. Not breaking, not severe.
